title: physiology.json - engine constants and compensation curve
description: Single home for baseline ranges, ATLS shock classes, effect-token mapping (TUNE) and bleed-class rates (TUNE). Skeleton holds placeholders only.

baselines.description: Adult resting ranges. Values are [low, high] or TODO_CLINICAL.

shockClasses.description: ATLS classes I-IV keyed by blood-loss fraction, with expected signs.

effectTokens.description: Maps drug effect tokens (+, ++, +++, -, --, ---) to numbers. TUNE.

bleedRates_mL_per_min.description: Maps trauma_library bleed classes to mL/min. TUNE.
